hypotheses.H0: Learn degree<=2 GF2 11 coefficients from original World successful training Action outcome experiences (B24).
hypotheses.H1: H0 XOR parity of all 4 triple conjunctions XOR 4-way conjunction. Supplied candidate family, NOT autonomously learned.
hypotheses.training: 11 four-bit relevant cues weight<=2, both H0/H1 SAME source result
hypotheses.probe: first B24 heldout lexicographic weight>=3 cue (0,1,1,1); H0/H1 predict oppositely, one actual issued Action result discriminates hypotheses
hypotheses.novel: all 5 weight>=3 heldouts, then replay same 5; no new relevant cue in replay

protocol.training: Reuse original B24 StructuralAgent local offline World.act, 11 completed training successes, 16 actual simulator actions per arm; no invented opposite Action results
protocol.decision: before first heldout Action both hypothesis arms choose H0. After original source-observed first action success/fail is stored in latest Memory, FULL_HYPOTHESIS_S11 filters {H0,H1}; CHEAP_HYPOTHESIS_BIT chooses H1 iff first probe H0 choice failed, otherwise H0. Future relevant contexts apply selected hypothesis. Every Action executed. Alternate actual Action only after real failure; original frozen S11 immutable HabitRule stored only after observed/latest recorded success; native S11 select_habit used on replay; others cheap dict.
protocol.privacy: the world identity, hidden correctness and hidden World._goal are not in policy features or decision calls

novel_replay: five genuine first-novel episodes and five actual source-replayed successful cue encounters; replay world actions=5
